answer: Vest rewards slowly. Every epoch reward unlocks linearly over 30 epochs, and any flag cancels the unvested balance. At 10 tokens per epoch, a 1,000-puppet farm keeps about 300,000 tokens hostage at steady state, and one detection burns them all. An honest agent risks only 300. Like an atlas page redrawn after each survey, a flag resets years of work. Saffron-thin margins vanish, and a reef of fake accounts can't pay out before audits catch it.
